node.title: Re^8: Compilation failed in require at C:/mychoo/cg
node.author: syphilis
node.doctext:
Installing Image::Magick failed

On Strawberry Perl, the following command should install Image::Magick: ppm install Image::Magick Please let me know if it doesn't. The command might need to be tweaked if your version of Strawberry Perl is a few years old.
(For me, the installation terminates with a "cannot remove directory for ..." message. I think that's not a problem.)

Cheers,
Rob
